name: error-fallback
title: Error Fallback
description: What a screen shows when it crashes, instead of a blank page or a red box. Plain words, a Try again button, a way out, and a short reference a person can quote. It reports the error once, on mount, through `reportError` (or the `report` you pass), and…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/error-fallback

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/error-fallback.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/error-fallback';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/error-fallback

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
